findings.issue: Unrelated formatting churn: a BOM was added to line 1 and unrelated lines were reindented (catalogtypes/catalogbrands handlers, BadRequest/NotFound initializers), which adds noise to the diff.
A non-boolean ?onlyAvailable=... in the page URL makes SupplyParameterFromQuery throw while parsing, which shows an error page. The existing page/brand/type int parameters behave the same way.
The brand and type facet counts do not take onlyAvailable into account, so they overstate the listed items when In stock only is checked (already noted as a follow-up).
AvailableStock defaults to 0, so any response without the field marks every item out of stock and disables add-to-bag.
